title: the backlog empties itself
line: 24 new issues triaged and planned into a cycle without leaving the keyboard.

title: one small lesson a day
line: A streak climbs to 365 while the lessons flip by, with the ad's words in Hebrew.

title: the code is the checkout
line: The real 18-line Checkout Session call builds the hosted page as it types.

title: on time after all
line: The road turns red, drivers report the jam, and Waze takes you around it.

title: one page, every shape
line: The same six tasks become a list, a board, a calendar, a table and a wiki.

title: there's always another one
line: Real clips stack into a 3D tower, the feed dives through it, then snaps back to one video.

title: the ad edits itself
line: Splits, a speed change and captions land on the timeline just ahead of the playhead, on real footage.

title: one photo, every format
line: One photo morphs from post to Story to Reel to a profile grid, in Hebrew, in one take.

title: design once, every shape
line: A flyer designs itself, then resizes into a post, banner, slides, poster and card.

title: what was already there
line: Every slider regrades a real photo pixel by pixel as it moves, with the ad's words in Hebrew.

title: one tile
line: One overgrown tile is cleared, planted and farmed through a year, then the whole farm rises around it, in voxels drawn in code.

title: follow the sun
line: One unbroken push through each scene's sun into the next hour of the desert, with the game's own press-kit art.
